
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# --- paths ---
root <- "/home/sebbah/Bureau/NcbiExtracted"
out_dir <- root

# --- what to exclude inside metadata ---
exclude_meta_types <- c(
  "pdf","png","jpg","jpeg","svg","gif","tif","tiff",
  "markdown","nxml","html","htm","doc","docx","ppt","pptx","bib","ris","nfo"
)

# =========================================================
# 1) Read manifests
# =========================================================
data_manifests <- list.files(root, pattern = "data_manifest\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
meta_manifests <- list.files(root, pattern = "metadata_manifest\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

if (length(data_manifests) + length(meta_manifests) == 0) {
  stop("No data_manifest.csv / metadata_manifest.csv found under: ", root)
}

read_manifest <- function(f, kind) {
  # Expected: .../<disease>/<PMCID>/<data|metadata>/(data|metadata)_manifest.csv
  disease <- basename(dirname(dirname(dirname(f))))
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(disease = disease, kind = kind)
}

all_files <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(data_manifests, read_manifest, kind = "data"),
  map_dfr(meta_manifests, read_manifest, kind = "metadata")
)

# remove unwanted categories INSIDE metadata only
all_files_f <- all_files %>%
  filter(!(kind == "metadata" & category %in% exclude_meta_types))

# =========================================================
# 2) Global counts
# =========================================================
global_counts <- all_files_f %>%
  count(kind, category, sort = TRUE)

write_csv(global_counts, file.path(out_dir, "global_counts_from_manifests_NOimages.csv"))

# Top categories (all kinds combined)
top_global <- global_counts %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

# Plot 1: Barplot (light blue) + labels
p1 <- ggplot(top_global, aes(x = reorder(category, total), y = total)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = total), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top file categories (all diseases) — NO images/pdf/etc",
    x = "File category",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(top_global$total) * 1.1)

print(p1)

# =========================================================
# 3) Heatmap "density" by disease (choose top categories)
# =========================================================
top_cats <- global_counts %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25) %>%         # adjust if you want more/less
  pull(category)

disease_counts <- all_files_f %>%
  count(disease, kind, category, name = "n") %>%
  filter(category %in% top_cats)

# Heatmap for DATA only (executables/models etc). If you want metadata too, remove the filter.
p2 <- disease_counts %>%
  filter(kind == "data") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = disease, y = category, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density of file types per disease (DATA only)",
    x = "Disease",
    y = "File category",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p2)

# =========================================================
# 4) How many unique models per disease (PMCID)
# =========================================================
p3 <- all_files_f %>%
  distinct(disease, pmcid) %>%
  count(disease, name = "n_models") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(disease, n_models), y = n_models)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_models), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of unique models (PMCIDs) per disease",
    x = "Disease",
    y = "Unique PMCIDs"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max((all_files_f %>% distinct(disease, pmcid) %>% count(disease))$n) * 1.1)

print(p3)

# =========================================================
# BONUS: check .r files (category == "r") in DATA
# =========================================================
r_files_check <- all_files_f %>%
  filter(kind == "data", category == "r") %>%
  count(disease, name = "n_r_files") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_r_files))

print(r_files_check)

# Optional save plots
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plot_top_categories_lightblue.png"), p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_density_data_lightblue.png"), p2, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plot_models_per_disease_lightblue.png"), p3, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```
